# Economy migration fixture

`economy-v110.suns` is synthetic test data, not a user's saved game.

It was produced by compiling `economy_v110_writer.cpp` against the original
headers, core and `src/app/save_game.cpp` at
`a1a5b87916dbdf9a8f0d6724b058d15c38afc17f` (PR #277, save v110), with
GCC 14.2 / Qt 6.8.2 and QDataStream's Qt 6.4 wire format.

SHA-256: `32e29da6207a2b7e7bbde5fabc0ef2421b9f2256ec4a15e34f1881bce032d298`.

The source uses explicit campaign/token IDs and contains a partially paid
factory batch, annual factory rule, production template, pending order and
received owner observation. The v111 migration test checks the four resources
already paid on the first factory, consistent template/annual repricing, basic
building counts, unchanged technology/RP/history, and actual continuation after
a new-format round trip. This is an original v110 writer result, not a v111 file
with its header renamed.

To regenerate, build Suns::Core at that commit without app/tests, compile the
fixture writer together with that commit's `src/app/save_game.cpp`, link the old
core archive and Qt6::Core, and pass the desired fixture path as its one argument.
Do not build this writer against current headers: its purpose is preserving the
previous release's layout and recipes.

## Template intent fixtures

The six `template-intent-*` files are synthetic data produced by
`template_intent_v119_writer.cpp` against the unmodified writer, headers and
core at `1d0ca997883ce3328143efc8b62630ebb7652424`, GCC14.2 / Qt6.12 with
QDataStream Qt6.4 encoding. Rebuild the generator against that revision, never
the current writer. These are genuine save119/orders49 files, not modern
payloads with renamed version headers.

Host/player saves and order packets carry the same adjacent Delete/Save payload.
The descriptions distinguish a real Rename from two independent editor actions.
The new reader must preserve a rejected rename's source and honor an independent
Delete before the rejected Save. Tests also cover the resulting modern inbox
round trip, where display descriptions are no longer available.

## Native support migration fixtures

at main `99b47dedb7fe6beb107d4c8507095aabecb35d2c`, GCC14.2 / Qt6.12 and
QDataStream Qt6.4 encoding. They contain the paid protected 25,000-resident

## Population v111 follow-up fixture

`population-v111.suns` was written by `population_v111_writer.cpp` compiled with
original headers, core and save writer at
`109afcaa11eb935bcc5357b04b8959dae4af3a2e` (PR #278 before population changes),
GCC14.2 / Qt6.8.2. It is synthetic data, not a user's game. It deliberately keeps
1,000,000 inhabitants and the old million-person turn-1 ledger; it also contains
advanced subsets, partially paid basic factories, annual/template work and RP.

SHA-256: `5c338536f647cf7f72b33cee915270af776f25f2b864ea79e48b3057cd824b5f`.

The v112 test checks unchanged counts/ledger/RP/paid work, the implicit old 10%
maximum growth rate, valid new-format persistence and identical real continuation.
This file came from the actual v111 writer, not a v112 header downgrade.
